# Tour: bottom sheet, footer, page scroll and spotlight insets

- Files: `feedback/Tour.tsx`
- Change: `sheet` (the card docks as a bottom sheet), `footer` (secondary
  actions under the step buttons), `scrollTarget` (the page scrolls the
  target itself) and `spotlightInsets` (the spotlight stays in the part of
  the viewport the sheet leaves free; a taller target is cut to it).
- Why: page tours on phones (`src/features/pageTour/`).
- Upstream: not submitted; carry it over when the file is re-copied from the registry.
